newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower in commission selling.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower in commission selling.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended broadly lower amid fund- and commission-related selling brought about by a break in technical support, traders said.
"We saw a lot of selling, especially toward the close, by the funds. Cargill sold a million March (bushels) as stops were hit," a trader said. "Plus cash basis levels were steady to slightly easier."

MGE spring wheat also drew pressure from CBOT wheat, which weakened on the posting of 700,000 bushels of notices for delivery on the CBOT December contract. No delivery notices were posted for MGE spring wheat.

U.S. wheat markets also drew pressure after the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics pegged the country's 1996-97 wheat crop at 21.3 million tonnes, up from the previous estimate of 20.9 million.

MGE spring wheat closed 6-1/4 to 11 cents per bushel lower, with December down 7-3/4 cents at $4.13-1/4. March lost seven cents to close at $3.73. The Dec/March spread narrowed to trade late at 40 cents over. It settled at 41 cents Monday.
Traders said Benson Quinn sold 1.5 million March and ADM sold 600,000 March.
MGE barley ended 20 to 21 cents per cwt lower. March barley closed down 20 cents at $6.42 per cwt.
